description: This script provides a runtime dependency installation guard for a Python project, attempting to ensure certain critical packages are available by trying to import them and installing them if missing. It specifically checks for packages like 'jose', 'fastapi', 'starlette', and 'uvicorn'.

methods.name: None _ensure(pkg: str, spec: str | None = None)
methods.description: Tries to import a specified package; if not found, attempts to install it via pip using subprocess.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Executes dependency checks and installations for critical runtime packages.

ctags.name: _ensure
ctags.pattern: /^def _ensure(pkg: str, spec: str | None = None) -> None:$/
